# 💥 GAMES CRASHING? — NVIDIA DRIVER FIX

**September 2026 · NVIDIA 616.xx driver regression**

> Random crashes lately? Games force-closing, **"GPU Crash Dump Triggered"** messages, or crashes pointing to `kernel32` / `ntdll` — across **multiple unrelated games**? It's probably not the games. **It's the driver.**

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🔍 The Culprit
NVIDIA's **616.xx** driver branch — including the current **616.92** (released Sep 9) — has known stability regressions. NVIDIA officially acknowledges some crashes (*Assassin's Creed Shadows* crashing to desktop after extended play, certain games failing to launch), but plenty of other games are affected too and just aren't on the official list yet.

**Quick check:** open the **NVIDIA App** or **NVIDIA Control Panel** — if you're on a **616.xx** driver, that's very likely your problem.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🛠️ The Fix — Roll Back the Driver
Don't just *reinstall* — you need to fully wipe the driver and go back to an older, stable version.

### 1️⃣ Download the Old Driver First
Go to **[nvidia.com/drivers](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/)**, find your exact GPU and grab **610.88** (the last version before the 616 branch). Save it somewhere you'll remember.

### 2️⃣ Download DDU
Get **[Display Driver Uninstaller](https://www.wagnardsoft.com/display-driver-uninstaller-DDU-)** from Wagnardsoft's official site and extract the zip.

### 3️⃣ Boot Into Safe Mode
**Settings → System → Recovery → Advanced startup → Restart now**
then **Troubleshoot → Advanced options → Startup Settings → Restart** → press **4** for Safe Mode.

### 4️⃣ Run DDU
Select **GPU → NVIDIA → Clean and restart**. This wipes every trace of the current driver — not just a normal uninstall.

### 5️⃣ Install 610.88
Once Windows boots back up normally, run the driver you saved → **Custom install** → check **Perform a clean installation** if it's offered.

### 6️⃣ Test Your Games
Crashes gone? You're good — just **avoid auto-updating** until NVIDIA actually fixes the 616 branch.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
-# ✅ Confirmed fix for crashes in *Dawnwalker* and *Bodycam* — good luck!
